cross_item: Strong cross-item pattern in both units. Within each version the five claimed answers sit in the same position (v0 always the 1st choice, v1 the 2nd, v2 the 3rd, v3 the 4th), and they all follow one storyline. In P01, v0 is shortcut and time, v1 is mistake into crisps, v2 is help, v3 is promise and four dozen. In P02, v0 is money and cost, v1 is Otto, v2 is the count, v3 is high water and safety. Choice texts repeat the version's keyword across questions (for example 'help' in P01 v2 Q1/Q2/Q5, 'promise' and 'four dozen' in v3, 'count' in P02 v2 Q1/Q3/Q4). A reader who solves the theme or central-idea question can match the other non-vocabulary answers by that keyword without rereading. The vocabulary items (Q4 in P01, Q2 in P02) are the exception: they are decided by local context alone.
